name: Voices of Life
editorial_article: The Voices of Life is a Florida-based community choir founded in 2019 by the veteran musical arranger and creative consultant Derric Johnson. Operating out of Lifebridge Church in Horizon West, the ensemble was established as a dedicated creative home for what Johnson termed "choir orphans"—passionate vocalists who sought a choral outlet despite their home congregations lacking a dedicated choir ministry. The group grew rapidly from an initial 40 members to nearly 80 within its first year, establishing a reputation for performances that blend professional-grade choral finesse with heartfelt spiritual conviction. \n\nDirector Derric Johnson brings decades of industry experience to the ensemble, having spent over 33 years as a creative consultant for Walt Disney World Resort, where he notably arranged and produced music for Epcot Center’s legendary group, The Voices of Liberty, as well as the annual Christmas Candlelight Processional. This professional pedigree informs the choir’s emphasis on vocal blend, staging, and immersive storytelling. Their repertoire is diverse, ranging from traditional spirituals and patriotic music to thematic seasonal productions like their "Colors of Christmas" show. By drawing members from multiple local congregations, The Voices of Life serves as a collaborative community hub that prioritizes the communal joy of harmonic singing. The ensemble’s philosophy rests on a foundation of faith, technical excellence, and the sheer fun of artistic expression, aiming to connect with audiences on a visceral, emotional level rather than simply through technical execution. Through these regular performances, the group continues to serve as an essential creative outlet for singers in Central Florida. By bridging the gap between professional artistry and community participation, the group occupies a unique niche in the local religious and musical landscape.

Operative out of Lifebridge Church, the choir provides a platform for singers from various local congregations to perform high-caliber arrangements.
